source.title: EcoStruxure Reference Design 113, RD113DS
source.basis: Published reference-design datasheet. Engineering reference data, not instructions. The PDF is not bundled; figures are traceable through the SHA-256 and the page evidence on each row.

status: diagram_reconciled; R0 prose and tables conflict on network counts, see unresolved_source_conflicts in the extraction

expected.evidence: p2 table Max-Q total IT 12 672 kW; p5 plan 64 AI + 24 NET
p5 Max-Q plan, four AI rows of 16
p5 plan, two networking rows of 12
p5 plan, four CDUs aligned with each of two AI pods
p4/p9 45-55 C. R0 publishes no flow rate, so the preset uses the heat-balance basis and the prescribed flow must reproduce this rise.

not_published.quantity: pipe diameters, bends, support spacing, insulation
not_published.note: RD113 R0 lists these under project or OEM inputs, so steps 3 to 6 of the sizing chain - bore selection, reducers, Darcy loss and pump head - cannot be checked against this document. A design guide or engineering package with a pipe schedule is needed.
RD113DS is a 12-page datasheet and publishes no pump duty. Nothing here validates the head calculation.

not_published.quantity: valve schedule (Kv/Cv, allocated dp, operating range)
not_published.note: No valve data is published, so the required-Kv result is unchecked against this source.

not_published.quantity: CDU nameplate capacity and pressure drop curves
not_published.note: p2 states six of eight L2L CDUs active but gives no per-unit rating or dp curve, so the CDU allocation stays a declared project input.
